items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: We played the first part for Guitar Slim. Then we took intermission, we went back in, we put our green uniforms on to come back and play with Jesse Allen.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I want to hear your version.

So I told Jose, I said, yeah, man, I said, Earl, Earl can do this for you. He said, yes? I said, yeah. So I went up there and went knocked on his door. I said, man, look, Jose want to see you. He said, we might have a gig for you. You know all Slim's tunes. Yeah, Cotton, I know him. He came on down. We met Jose and Jose said, yeah, well, we're going to go to Bessma, Alabama. So then we said, well, Ray Charles is supposed to come. I said, but Ray Charles in California, he won't be able to make that date. So we…
